Key.loadFailed: Could not load your key from the server: {error}
Key.backupBody: Your encrypted key is stored with your account, protected by your encryption password. Keep a copy of the recovery file as well: if you forget the password, or the service disappears, this file is the only other way back in. It is encrypted with your password too.
Key.registerBody: Publish your public key on-chain so others can encrypt to you. The private key stays here.
Key.setupBody: This password protects your encryption key, which is generated in your browser. It is separate from your wallet and cannot be reset: we only ever store the key in encrypted form and never see the password.
Key.forgot: Forgot your password? Use a recovery file instead
Key.importPassword: A recovery file keeps the password it was created with. Choose a file whose password you remember. It replaces the copy stored with your account, and you then unlock it with that password.
Key.importMismatch: The key stored for this account does not match the key registered on-chain. Import the correct recovery file.
Key.importNotStored: An encryption key is already registered on-chain for this account, but it is not stored with your account. Import your recovery file to continue.
Key.importNoFile: No file, or no password you remember? Nobody can reset it for you; see <link>what you can still do</link>.
Key.wrongAccount: This recovery file belongs to a different account
Key.wrongKey: This recovery file does not match the key registered on-chain

Session.heading: Prove this wallet is yours.
Session.body: You will be asked to sign a short message. It is free, sends no transaction, and cannot move any funds.
Session.signatureRejected: Signature request rejected in your wallet.
Session.profileBody: Your name and email are stored off-chain only, so the people you invite (or who invite you) know who is who. They never go on the blockchain.
Session.emailHint: Must match the address the invitation was sent to.

Shell.connectBody: Your wallet is your identity. Everything you upload is encrypted here in your browser first, and your encryption key never leaves it unprotected.
Shell.noWallet: No browser wallet found. Install MetaMask to continue.
Shell.notDeployed: Heirloom is not deployed on {chain} yet.
Shell.unsupportedNetwork: Your wallet is on a network Heirloom does not support.
Shell.noDeployments: No deployments found. Run a deploy script in contracts/.
Shell.assure3: Every action on a public audit trail
